proposals.title: Independent Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt policy and amend bylaws so the Board Chair is, whenever possible, an independent director, phased in at the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends you vote AGAINST Items 5 through 13 for the reasons we give after each one.

proposals.title: Majority Vote for Directors
proposals.proponent: Southwest Regional Council of Carpenters Pension Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Amend bylaws so director nominees are elected by majority of votes cast in uncontested elections, retaining plurality for contested elections.
proposals.evidence: This resignation policy coupled with the current plurality vote standard yields the same outcome as a majority-vote standard.

proposals.title: Special Shareholder Meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Amend bylaws to give holders of 15% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareowner meeting.
proposals.evidence: Since shareholders already have an effective right to seek a special shareholder meeting, the Board does not support the proposal.

proposals.title: Restrict Precatory Proposals
proposals.topic_summary: Amend bylaws to no longer permit shareholders to submit precatory proposals unless the board approves their submission.
proposals.evidence: The Board shares the proponent's concern regarding certain shareholders perpetuating proposals that offer little or no benefit to corporate governance
